name: Navigation aids
description: Offshore structures are marked as a single unit, block or field under IALA G1162: white main/secondary lanterns flashing Morse U, red subsidiary lights, ID panels, fog signals, racon and optional aviation obstruction lighting.
aliases: Navigation aids (fog horn, marine lanterns, aircraft obstruction lighting, racon/marine radar transponder)
